annotations.title: Search the hazmat table by name

description: Find hazardous materials by proper shipping name (fuzzy, e.g. "acetone", "lithium batteries") in the 49 CFR 172.101 table, with their UN numbers and classes. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

class.description: Only this hazard class or division (3, 2.1, 1.4S, forbidden...).
